issue_context.title: Strictly checking column pruning would not cause empty column output for each operator
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Zero column after column pruning is quite dangerous. We need to check it during our testing to avoid such cases.

TableDual is a special case. It's bonded with Projection. It only uses virtualRowNum.

review_comments: Now that we remove `addConstOneForEmptyProjection` here, it probably means we can also remove that in `(*LogicalApply).PruneColumns()`. We can have a check.
Yes, i forgot to remove it. Last week is too busy(
If we don't add this, we'll get `Proj->Sort->Dual` for `Proj->Dual`.
